paragraphs: Create a film class with the instance variables `name` (String) and `ageRating` (int). Write the constructor `public Film(String filmName, int filmAgeRating)` for the class, and also the methods `public String name()` and `public int ageRating()`. The first of these returns the film title and the second returns its rating.
